turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, quick one. I'm at the stop and I can see two buses coming. Both go near the hospital.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The first one stops outside the main entrance but crawls through town. The second is faster but drops you a few streets away. Which one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a bit, my kid needs me. I'll come back to you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hannah, taste this frosting. Too sweet?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hmm. It's sweet, but it's a birthday cake, so that's kind of the point.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I was thinking of adding lemon juice.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Ooh, lemon would be nice. Just a little.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you squeeze one for me? My hands are covered in sugar.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: In the bowl by the window.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, door to door, or faster and a short walk?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The slow one. I've got a bad ankle.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then that's the right call. It's a slower ride, but no walking at the other end.
